title: The grinder
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Wednesday. The grinder. Gully grinds bait-shop coarse. The first shot pulls in four seconds. Wood times it on the bait-tank clock. 'That's a sneeze.' 'That's a shot.' 'That's a sneeze, Gully.'

panels.composition: The shack. GULLY at a hand grinder, cranking like a winch. WOOD on the crate. No dog — he's still gone.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a teenager in an apron cranking a hand coffee grinder like a winch in a bait shack while another sits on a crate, no dog

panels.composition: The grounds. Coarse as gravel. In the portafilter.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of coarse gravel-like coffee grounds in an espresso portafilter

panels.composition: The shot. Wood watching the bait-tank clock. Four seconds. A cup of pale water.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a teenager pulling an espresso shot while another times it on a wall clock, a cup of pale liquid

panels.composition: Gully cranking the grinder finer. Grim. Wood drawing the crank. The strip about a crank.
